title: Pikachu Raises Its Tail, And Lightning Sometimes Strikes It
premise: Pikachu raises its tail to monitor its surroundings, and lightning sometimes strikes the tail in that pose.
audiencePromise: Reveal why Pikachu raises its tail, then show the lightning warning tied to that exact pose.
openLoop: Why does Pikachu raise a tail that lightning sometimes strikes?
payoff: Pikachu raises its tail to check its surroundings, but that exact pose is sometimes when lightning strikes it.
engagementQuestion: Raise it to look around, or keep it down?

voice.instructions: Use a tense, curious pace. Start sharply, pause before each reveal, and make the final choice playful but serious.
